description.en: Plays back the high-quality scripted cutscene set up with CMND_HQ_EVENT_INIT/CMND_REG_HDL_HQ_EVENT/etc. as a child scene, with a sound cue, cut number and an option to end on a white fade.
Sound cue configuration for the cutscene.
Which cut/take of the cutscene to play.
Whether the cutscene should end on a white fade.

Likely true once the child scene was created; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments). The success value is produced by an internal scene-creation helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Play back the prepared HQ event cutscene
CMND_MAKE_CHILD_HQ_EVENT_SCENE(snd, _cutNum, _endWhiteFade);
